scope: Codex visual review of all 8 paired source/base/trained reconstructions and all 8 query-only trained generations; subjective diagnostics, not expert GT or retrieval evaluation
reconstruction_observations: Base and trained samples remain visually similar overall; no clear consistent quality improvement established.
Source cut, sleeve, length, viewpoint and color are often not preserved; purple garment example is generated as grayscale.

query_observations.notes: Black, long sleeves and lace appear; output is a collage and the requested looser skirt is not established.
Black/white striped tank appearance present, with added leggings and weak reference-item preservation.
Blue floral pattern present; source short sleeveless shape becomes a long sleeved floor-length garment.
Hot pink maxi and neck strap broadly present; fine reference-item preservation unverified.
Black/white animal-like pattern present; cropped image prevents full shape/length verification.
Reference dress replaced by a separate shirt and denim shorts; requested shorter sleeves does not justify garment-category change.
Yellow sleeveless color/style partly present, but generated tunic plus pants changes the requested dress composition.
Darker color present but output is a multi-person, multi-garment collage rather than a single pseudo-target image.

conclusion: Training pipeline works, but this small domain pilot does not justify replacing Qwen generation or claiming retrieval gains.
